issue_review.finding_summary: GAD65去酰胺化产生特定HLA限制的新表位，增强相应T细胞识别。
issue_review.method_excerpt: GAD65-reactive antibodies are common in individuals with DRB1*03:01 haplotypes and diabetes, and benefits from GAD65 therapy are linked to DRB1*03:01 genotypes. DRB1*03:01 prefers Asp in binding pocket 4, such that Asn deamidation, a modification documented in islets, could generate neoepitopes. DRB1*03:01 should present GAD65 epitopes, but few have been reported. We aimed to identify DRB1*03:01-restricted GAD65 epitopes recognized in individuals with type 1 diabetes (T1D). We defined wild-type and Asn-deamidated GAD65 epitopes that are bound by DRB1*03:01 and assessed their immunogenicity through in vitro T-cell assays. In total, three deami
issue_review.result_excerpt: clinical trials. DRB1*03:01 is associated with GAD65 autoantibodies and immune modulation with GAD65 protein, but few reliable epitopes have been reported. We aimed to identify relevant GAD65 epitopes recognized in individuals positive for DRB1*03:01. We identified regions of GAD65 that are recognized by CD4+ T cells in individuals with DRB1*03:01 haplotypes and type 1 diabetes, including wild-type and Asn-deamidated epitopes. T cells recognized deamidated GAD65 with higher affinity than wild-type GAD65. GAD65-specific T cells are present among islet-derived T cells from pancreatic organ donors, suggesting a direct role in islet autoimmunity.

issue_review.method_excerpt: Twenty-nine youths with obesity underwent OGTT while wearing a FreeStyle Libre 2 sensor. Raw CGM values were temporally aligned with venous plasma glucose values and used to reconstruct plasma profiles via a first-order plasma-interstitial kinetic model and inverse filtering. Accuracy, agreement, consensus error grid, and glycemic classification were compared with collected venous plasma glucose values.
issue_review.result_excerpt: Deconvolution-based CGM reconstruction may support plasma-referenced, less invasive OGTT-based dysglycemic assessment.

issue_review.finding_summary: 激活MSC分泌物在NOD小鼠中提供再生和免疫调节线索。
issue_review.method_excerpt: Human bone marrow-derived MSCs were licensed with CHIR99021, IFN-γ or a combination of both, for 24 h, to generate concentrated CHIR, IFN-γ or COMBO CdM, for intrapancreatic (iPan) injection into female NOD mice and for label-free MS-based secretome analyses. Short- and long-term glycaemic outcomes were assessed across type 1 diabetes recovery and prevention paradigms. Pancreas and spleen tissue were collected for tissue analyses to assess beta cell content and immune cell composition.
issue_review.result_excerpt: Combined pharmacological licensing of MSCs produces a biologically unique secretome with complementary regenerative and immunomodulatory properties that modulates autoimmune diabetes progression in NOD mice. These findings position MSC licensing and/or MSC CdM as an emerging therapeutic modality for the prevention of autoimmune destruction and regenerative medicine therapies for type 1 diabetes.

issue_review.finding_summary: 移植长期随访显示早期和后期肾功能下降不同，并存在性别及基线风险差异。
issue_review.method_excerpt: Mixed-effects models were used to assess eGFR decline rates (ml min-1 1.73 m-2 per year) stratified by sex and baseline eGFR. Acute eGFR changes were assessed within 3 months of each infusion. Univariate and multivariable Cox models and competing risk regression were used to identify factors associated with progression to stage 3b chronic kidney disease (CKD) or worse (eGFR <45 ml min-1 1.73 m-2) in individuals with baseline eGFR ≥45 ml min-1 1.73 m-2.
issue_review.result_excerpt: Although calcineurin inhibitor-based immunosuppression induces rapid early eGFR decline, its progression slows substantially beyond 5 years. Female sex and lower pre-transplant eGFR independently predicted CKD progression. This sex disparity remains to be fully understood, as male and female recipients did not differ in baseline eGFR or tacrolimus exposure. These findings establish a long-term renal safety benchmark within the largest and longest-running ITA programme, and identify subgroups who are most likely to benefit from emerging calcineurin inhibitor-free strategies.

issue_review.method_excerpt: This prospective longitudinal cohort study is part of the FaPDi cohort study. The study included pregnant women with type 1 diabetes and women without diabetes who gave birth at Aalborg University Hospital between November 2020 and April 2023. All participants were invited for MRI scans at 15-20, 26-30 and 34-38 weeks' gestation, from which fetal, placental and amniotic fluid volumes were obtained. The groups were compared across gestation using multiple linear regressions and mixed-effects models.
issue_review.result_excerpt: MRI provides a unique insight into the intrauterine consequences of type 1 diabetes. Pregnancies complicated by type 1 diabetes are characterised by increased fetal, placental and amniotic fluid volumes. The strong association between maternal HbA1c and amniotic fluid volume suggests that amniotic fluid dynamics may provide additional insight into the intrauterine consequences of maternal glucose regulation.

issue_review.method_excerpt: Immune-mediated rejection remains a major barrier to long-term success of islet/stem cell-derived islet transplantation for type 1 diabetes. We evaluated whether cotransplantation of human islets with human α-1 antitrypsin-overexpressing mesenchymal stromal/stem cells (AAT-MSCs) improves islet graft survival by modulating human immune responses in a humanized diabetic mouse model. Humanized NOD/SCID/IL2Rγ-/- (NSG) mice were generated by irradiation and transfer of human CD34+ hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells, resulting in stable T- and B-cell reconstitution. Diabetes was induced by multiple doses of low-dose streptozotocin (STZ), after whi
issue_review.result_excerpt: erived islet transplantation in type 1 diabetes, and strategies that protect the graft without systemic immunosuppression are needed. We asked whether cotransplanting human islets with α-1 antitrypsin-overexpressing mesenchymal stromal/stem cells (AAT-MSCs) improves graft outcomes in humanized mice, and how human immune responses are affected. AAT-MSC cotransplantation improved glycemic control, prolonged graft survival, and shifted immune responses toward a more regulatory, less inflammatory profile. These findings support further development of AAT-MSCs as an adjunct to reduce reliance on systemic immunosuppression in islet transplantation.

issue_review.finding_summary: 猪模型中母体糖尿病改变子代β细胞结构和信号，不能直接视作儿童临床结局。
issue_review.method_excerpt: Using genetically diabetic and beta cell reporter pig models, we performed functional assessments of glucose-stimulated insulin secretion in vivo and in situ using fresh pancreatic tissue slices from neonatal piglets born to hyperglycaemic mothers (PHGs) or normoglycaemic mothers (PNGs). Morphological and molecular profiling, including proteomics and single-cell RNA-seq, were performed to elucidate molecular changes reflecting the developmental impact of maternal diabetes on offspring metabolic health, with a particular focus on neonatal beta cells.
issue_review.result_excerpt: Our findings reveal altered islet modelling with a unique beta cell dysfunction profile that partially overlaps with, but differs from, that of type 2 diabetes. A shift towards a beta cell subcluster exhibiting an adaptive early-response-gene-mediated transcriptional reactivity and an ATF4-associated transcriptional stress signature provides insight into molecular alterations associated with fetal exposure to maternal diabetes and may contribute to the increased risk of metabolic disease in offspring.

issue_review.result_excerpt: ut understudied fat depot surrounding vessels supplying the pancreas, and its role in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) remains unclear. issue_review.method_excerpt: Hepatocyte growth factor (HGF)/c-Met signaling is a well-established pathway through which external signals regulate β-cell resilience and function. Here, we combined human islet single-cell transcriptomics with mouse pancreatic-cell profiling to show that pericytes, rather than endothelial cells, are the primary source of HGF in healthy islets. Using transgenic mouse tools and culture systems, we found that pericyte-derived HGF is required for β-cell function and glucose homeostasis. Adult mice lacking pericytic HGF in their pancreata de
issue_review.result_excerpt: atocyte growth factor (HGF)/c-Met pathway in β-cells and glucose homeostasis, the endogenous source of HGF in islets remains unclear. This study characterizes the pancreatic source of HGF and its physiological requirement in vivo. Pericytes were identified as the primary endogenous source of HGF in human and mouse islets. Pericytic HGF loss causes glucose intolerance by impairing insulin production through the regulation of key β-cell genes. Establishing β-cell mass during embryogenesis and pregnancy depends on mesenchymal/pericytic HGF. This study establishes the islet vasculature as a source of trophic factors required for glycemic control.

issue_review.method_excerpt: Circulating diabetes biomarkers have been identified with proteomics measured at a single time point, but what is additionally provided by longitudinal repeated measurements in the same individuals, over many years, is unknown. We studied participants in the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA; n = 5,322; mean baseline age, 61.7 years) at exams 1 (2000-2002), 5 (2010-2012), and 6 (2016-2018) profiled with the Olink Explore (3 K) platform. Associations with incident diabetes, mostly of type 2, were modeled using Cox proportional hazards with exam 1 proteins (i.e., single time point) and time-updating Cox with proteins from all three ex
issue_review.result_excerpt: The increase in biomarkers identified with longitudinal repeated measurements is supported by a similar proportion being nominated as causal for type 2 diabetes with Mendelian randomization. Proteins unique to the longitudinal repeated analyses highlighted biological pathways (e.g., posttranslational protein modification and cellular structure and cycle regulation) that were distinct from pathways enriched among the shared proteins (e.g., small-molecule metabolic and catabolic processes). Longitudinal protein measurements identify additional novel disease biomarkers and disparate biological pathways compared with single measurement analyses.

issue_review.method_excerpt: Hyperglycemia in prediabetes is accompanied by increased amino acid (AA) concentrations and impaired suppression of glucagon secretion by glucose. It is unknown whether an abnormal response to AA contributes or hepatic steatosis exacerbates α-cell dysfunction. Therefore, lean participants and participants with obesity (with and without hepatic steatosis) were studied on two occasions in random order using a graded glucose infusion. Saline or an AA mixture was infused. The glucagon secretion rate (GSR) was derived from peripheral glucagon concentrations, and the change in glucose required to reduce GSR by 50% (G50) was calculated for each part
issue_review.result_excerpt: s of α-cell dysfunction in prediabetes. The primary hypothesis was that α-cell responsivity to glucose (reduction of the glucagon secretion rate by 50%) is impaired by amino acid (AA) infusion. A secondary hypothesis was that this abnormal response is exacerbated by hepatic steatosis. AA infusion impaired α-cell suppression in response to rising glucose in participants with obesity, but not in lean participants, despite a normal response to glucose alone. This abnormal response was unaffected by the presence or absence of hepatic steatosis. It seems likely that an abnormal α-cell response to AAs precedes an abnormal response to glucose alone.

issue_review.result_excerpt: een therapeutic insulin administration and cardiac autonomic balance under free-living conditions remains unclear. issue_review.finding_summary: 三种限制热量饮食均减重，12周尿酸下降未显示显著组间差异。
issue_review.method_excerpt: In this 12-week, open-label, active-comparator randomized trial, 102 men with overweight or obesity and hyperuricemia were assigned 1:1:1 to a carbohydrate-restricted diet (CRD), Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension (DASH) diet, or low-purine balanced diet (LPBD). All groups followed a calorie-restricted prescription of 20-25 kcal/kg ideal body weight. The primary end point was change in SU from baseline to week 12.
issue_review.result_excerpt: In men with overweight or obesity and hyperuricemia, three calorie-restricted dietary patterns produced substantial weight loss but did not differ significantly in 12-week SU reduction. DASH was associated with higher adherence than both the CRD and LPBD and with less soft lean mass loss than the CRD. Early urate instability and coincident gout flares highlight the need for flare-risk management during structured dietary weight loss initiation.

issue_review.method_excerpt: In this multicenter study, 1,028 individuals contributed 3,441 longitudinal CGM profiles. Participants were stratified on the basis of age, chronic kidney disease (CKD), β-cell function, BMI, and triglyceride-glucose (TyG) tertile. Linear mixed-effects models were used to estimate subgroup differences in longitudinal changes.
issue_review.result_excerpt: Older age and CKD were associated with longitudinal glycemic improvement without worsening of hypoglycemia, whereas severe β-cell failure limited glycemic gains; substantial within-group heterogeneity supports individualized glycemic targets informed by CGM trajectories in type 1 diabetes.

issue_review.finding_summary: 细胞/动物实验连接Cryab乳酸化、蛋白稳定性与心肌功能。
issue_review.method_excerpt: Protein posttranslational modifications, including lactylation, have been intimately associated with myocardial energy metabolism. In this study, we investigated the role of Cryab in diabetic cardiomyopathy (DbCM) and its lysine lactylation (Kla). A spontaneous DbCM mouse model in db/db mice and a high-fat diet combined with i.p. streptozotocin injection mouse model were used. Primary cardiomyocytes were subjected to liposome-mediated transfection, followed by exposure to high glucose and palmitate. Cryab exhibited reduced Kla modification in myocardial tissue from DbCM mouse models and in damaged cardiomyocytes, while protein expression rema
issue_review.result_excerpt: thereby contributing to cardiac dysfunction associated with DbCM. These findings suggest that novel therapeutic strategies targeting protein Kla modification could be significant in the clinical management of DbCM. Cryab lysine lactylation (Kla) modification in myocardial tissue is reduced in db/db mice with diabetic cardiomyopathy (DbCM). Mutations in the Cryab Kla site exacerbate DbCM damage in vivo and in vitro. Cryab Kla enhances the stability of the Hspa1b protein by interacting with Hspa1b. Cryab blocks DbCM-induced MAPK signaling in an Hspa1b-dependent manner. Cryab/Hspa1b/MAPK signaling influences DbCM-associated cardiac dysfunction.

issue_review.method_excerpt: This study systematically dissects the regulatory role of CYP1B1 in the pathogenesis of diabetic kidney disease (DKD). CYP1B1 participates in the progression of DKD by mediating the metabolism of arachidonic acid, retinoic acid, and estradiol, as well as the process of ferroptosis. Its 4-OHE2 quinone metabolites and proferroptotic effect promote renal injury, while it is associated with the maintenance of renoprotective signaling. The net effect of CYP1B1 is regulated by substrate type, cell type, and disease stage, and it can serve as an epigenetic marker and gut-kidney axis mediator in DKD.

issue_review.finding_summary: T1D合并超重/肥胖的acmopatide二期试验提供特定人群的血糖与体重证据。
issue_review.method_excerpt: In this phase 2, 16-week, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter study, adults with T1D (HbA1c 7.0-10.0%; BMI ≥27 kg/m2) were randomized 1:1:1:1 to once-daily subcutaneous acmopatide (1.8, 4.1, or 6.6 mg) or volume-matched placebo. The primary end point was change from baseline (CFB) in HbA1c (%) at week 16; secondary end points included percent CFB in body weight and insulin dose.
issue_review.result_excerpt: In adults with T1D and overweight/obesity, acmopatide was associated with improved glycemic control and clinically meaningful weight loss without DKA or severe hypoglycemia events.

issue_review.result_excerpt: rough metabolic reprogramming. We sought to define the molecular mechanisms linking altered glucose metabolism to podocyte mitochondrial dysfunction. issue_review.finding_summary: 产后GDM人群激素响应存在族群差异，并非更高胰岛素可由更高肠促胰素解释。
issue_review.method_excerpt: We measured glucagon, GIP and GLP-1 in 178 South Asian and 107 Nordic women during an OGTT, and stratified participants by glycaemic status. Glucagon and total GLP-1 and GIP responses when fasting and post-OGTT were assessed by linear mixed models. Ethnic differences in incretin and glucagon levels were evaluated by linear regression analyses. Pre-hepatic insulin levels were estimated using deconvolution of C-peptide kinetics.
issue_review.result_excerpt: When examined 1-3 years post-GDM, normoglycaemic South Asian women had less early glucagon suppression and higher total glucagon exposure post-OGTT compared with Nordic women. The higher pre-hepatic insulin levels were not associated with higher incretin levels, but were associated with lower insulin sensitivity.

issue_review.finding_summary: 长期人群比较显示新诊断T2D的年龄、共病和血糖脂质管理特征发生变化。
issue_review.method_excerpt: This retrospective cohort study used electronic health record data from Clalit Health Services (Haifa & Western Galilee, Israel). Adults with incident type 2 diabetes in 2005-2008 (period 1: n=80,201) were compared with those diagnosed in 2020-2023 (period 2: n=101,392). Between-period differences are presented as crude estimates, with an age-stratified sensitivity analysis, and quantified using standardised mean differences (SMDs; values ≥0.20 indicate at least a small effect) alongside non-parametric and χ2 tests.
issue_review.result_excerpt: The phenotype of newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes has been fundamentally restructured since 2008: patients are older with a higher comorbidity burden but present with better glycaemic and lipid management, with the latter reflecting statin therapy already established before diagnosis. MASLD has emerged as a major but largely ascertainment-driven comorbidity. The shift to SGLT2 inhibitors and GLP-1RAs alongside declining sulfonylurea use indicates displacement of glucose-centric strategies by a cardiorenal- and weight-driven paradigm. These findings indicate a need for age-appropriate management and trials enrolling very elderly patients.

issue_review.method_excerpt: We identified dermatopontin (DPT) as a previously unrecognized compensatory regulator that is upregulated in skeletal muscle in obesity and preserves muscle function and systemic metabolic homeostasis, offering a potential therapeutic target for metabolic disorders. Mechanistically, DPT activates an adaptive PERK/eIF2α/ATF4 endoplasmic reticulum stress axis specifically under metabolic stress, but not under normal conditions, which enhances muscle function and directly counteracts metabolic deterioration, revealing a protective signaling cascade. This DPT-driven endoplasmic reticulum stress axis transcriptionally upregulates growth differenti
issue_review.result_excerpt: ntial therapeutic target for metabolic disorders. Mechanistically, DPT activates an adaptive PERK/eIF2α/ATF4 endoplasmic reticulum stress axis specifically under metabolic stress, but not under normal conditions, which enhances muscle function and directly counteracts metabolic deterioration, revealing a protective signaling cascade. This DPT-driven endoplasmic reticulum stress axis transcriptionally upregulates growth differentiation factor (GDF) 15 expression and secretion in muscle. Muscle-derived GDF15 exerts both local muscle-autonomous and systemic protective effects, uncovering a previously unrecognized muscle-to-organ cross-talk axis.

issue_review.finding_summary: 小鼠实验连接餐前橄榄油、胃排空及激素神经通路，尚非人体饮食建议。
issue_review.method_excerpt: We undertook this study to define how fat consumed before oral glucose attenuates postchallenge glycemia. We asked whether olive oil reduces glycemia by slowing gastric emptying and investigated contributing endocrine and neural pathways. Olive oil increased glucagon, glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide, and glucagon-like peptide-1; slowed gastric emptying; and reduced early glycemia in mice. Glucagon and glucagon-like peptide-1 signaling acted redundantly, with vagal involvement. Nutrient timing integrates endocrine-neural regulation of gastric emptying and glycemia, supporting evaluation of meal sequencing in humans.

issue_review.method_excerpt: A total of seven South Asian and six European participants, matched for age and BMI, underwent deuterium magnetic resonance scans at baseline and after 5 days of 2H water enrichment, from which the fractional and absolute amounts of liver fat from DNL (DNLMR) were calculated. Proton magnetic resonance spectroscopy (1H-MRS) and MRI were used to determine lipid quantity and composition.
issue_review.result_excerpt: DNL or related factors may play a pivotal role in driving the increased liver fat and risk of diabetes in South Asian individuals. The novel methodology used to quantify DNL provides a powerful tool for studying DNL-derived liver fat in human metabolic disorders including diabetes.

issue_review.method_excerpt: Exosomes from palmitate- or PBS-treated 3T3-L1 adipocytes were applied to MIN6 cells and primary mouse islets to assess beta cell function and identity. In vivo, mice underwent adipose-specific Angptl2 knockdown under high-fat diet (HFD) feeding, followed by metabolic phenotyping and assessment of beta cell function. Adipose-derived exosomes from HFD-fed mice with or without adipose Angptl2 knockdown were injected into normal-chow-fed recipient mice, and endocrine marker composition and islet secretory function were evaluated. Mechanistic studies in MIN6 cells used co-immunoprecipitation, phar
issue_review.result_excerpt: Lipotoxic adipocyte-derived exosomes increase ANGPTL2 abundance in recipient beta cells and contribute to beta cell dysfunction and identity disruption by amplifying PERK-dependent EIF2α/ATF4/CHOP signalling. Adipose ANGPTL2 and circulating exosome-associated ANGPTL2 represent candidate targets and biomarkers for preserving beta cell function in obesity-associated dysglycaemia.

issue_review.result_excerpt: In a U.S.-representative population, adding 10- to 14-week OGTT or CGM criteria to clinical factors improved GDM but not LGA prediction. issue_review.result_excerpt: mmed death-ligand 1. issue_review.method_excerpt: Glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) promotes nutrient storage, but its vascular actions in skeletal muscle remain unclear. To determine whether GIP regulates muscle microvascular perfusion, a key determinant of substrate use, we examined GIP receptor (GIPR) expression in vascular endothelium and assessed GIP effects in vivo in chow-fed and high-fat diet (HFD)-fed rats. Overnight-fasted rats received 120-min infusions of saline or GIP, with or without concurrent insulin or glucagon-like peptide 1 (GLP-1). Immunofluorescence microscopy demonstrated clear GIPR expression in conduit, resistance, and microvascular vessel endothelium
issue_review.result_excerpt: ons of glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) in muscle are unknown. We investigated whether GIP regulates skeletal muscle microvascular perfusion and interacts with insulin and GLP-1 signaling. GIP receptors are expressed in vascular endothelium, yet GIP alone does not increase muscle perfusion and instead antagonizes insulin- and GLP-1-mediated microvascular recruitment via possibly angiotensin II type 1 receptor-dependent endothelin-1/nitric oxide imbalance. GIP acts as a conditional regulator of skeletal muscle microvascular perfusion, revealing a novel mechanism of tissue-specific incretin regulation of nutrient partitioning.

issue_review.finding_summary: EP3/EP4调节在自身免疫炎症模型中影响β细胞质量及局部炎症。
issue_review.method_excerpt: Type 1 diabetes is driven by both β-cell dysfunction and an autoreactive immune system, resulting in β-cell destruction and hyperglycemia. We previously showed that pharmacological modulation of prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) receptor (EP) signaling protects β-cells from cytokine-mediated death ex vivo and relieves oxidative stress and maintains β-cell identity in a mouse model of type 2 diabetes. Here we show that EP modulation protects against cytokine-mediated β-cell death in islets from nonobese diabetic (NOD) mice. Because PGE2 can also alter immune cell phenotypes, we tested whether EP modulation prevents β-cell destruction in a setting of agg
issue_review.result_excerpt: β-cell health and survival. In this study, we examined whether these β-cell effects could be harnessed alongside known PGE2-mediated immunomodulation to ameliorate β-cell loss in a model of severe islet autoimmunity. Simultaneous pharmacological blockade of the EP3 receptor and activation of the EP4 receptor maintain mature β-cell mass, ameliorate the proinflammatory insulitic microenvironment, and alter β-cell stress responses in female nonobese diabetic mice undergoing aggressive inflammatory assault. EP modulation shows promise to support β-cell resiliency and reduce inflammation in a setting of autoimmune attack, such as type 1 diabetes.

HPSE was selectively enriched in myeloid cells, particularly CD14++ classical monocytes from patients with T1D and NOD mice and was associated with activated proinflammatory and interferon signali
issue_review.result_excerpt: The role of the heparanase (HPSE)-heparan sulfate (HS) axis in type 1 diabetes remains incompletely defined. issue_review.result_excerpt: e, is altered in diabetes. We inactivated acyl protein thioesterase-1 (APT1), a key palmitoylation cycling enzyme, in adipose tissue to study how fat affects systemic metabolism. issue_review.finding_summary: 代谢组定义的糖尿病前期亚型对应不同心肾代谢风险及饮食关联。
issue_review.method_excerpt: Prediabetes is highly prevalent and biologically heterogeneous, yet current glycemic definitions do not adequately capture differences in cardiometabolic and kidney risk. We aimed to identify metabolically defined subtypes of prediabetes using circulating metabolites and to examine their associations with cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic outcomes. We analyzed 24,638 participants with prediabetes from the UK Biobank who had metabolomics data available. Metabolomic biomarkers related to type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and chronic kidney disease were identified using machine learning-based feature selection methods, and unsupervised clus
issue_review.result_excerpt: etabolomic biomarkers could define distinct prediabetes subtypes with differential type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and chronic kidney disease risk. Using 16 metabolomic biomarkers, we identify three metabolically distinct clusters showing progressively higher risks of incident type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and chronic kidney disease. Differential diet-cluster associations across clusters were obtained, and Mendelian randomization supported potential causal roles for several metabolomic biomarkers. Metabolomics-based stratification may improve risk prevention and enable cluster-specific dietary interventions in prediabetes.

issue_review.finding_summary: 脂酶对不同甘油三酯底物的选择性影响肥胖脂质重塑。
issue_review.method_excerpt: Obese adipose tissue is enriched in unsaturated triacylglycerol (TAG) species, yet the mechanisms driving this lipid remodeling remain incompletely understood. In this study, we conducted comprehensive lipidomic profiling of white adipose tissue from predominantly midlife obese individuals and consistently observed an enrichment of unsaturated TAG species. Acyl chain analysis of both TAGs and glycerophospholipids revealed a predominance of C18 unsaturated fatty acids (FAs), particularly FA 18:1 and FA 18:2. To investigate the mechanistic basis of this selective enrichment, we performed integrated functional assays of lipogenesis and lipolysis
issue_review.result_excerpt: hanism driving this selective lipid accumulation remains unclear. We investigated whether substrate-selective lipolysis contributes to the retention of unsaturated fatty acids (FAs) in obese adipose tissue. Lipidomic profiling revealed predominant enrichment of FA 18:1 and FA 18:2 in midlife-predominant obese adipose TAGs, and functional assays showed that adipose triglyceride lipase preferentially hydrolyzes saturated TAGs under conditions of sufficient substrate supply. These results identify lipase substrate selectivity as a mechanistic contributor to lipid remodeling in obesity and a potential target for modulating adipose lipid turnover.

issue_review.finding_summary: 脑龄研究未显示疼痛本身的清晰贡献，病程更重要，不能只突出神经痛因素。
issue_review.method_excerpt: Structural brain alterations, including accelerated brain aging, occur in diabetes, as seen via MRI. The brain age gap (BAG) is likely caused by a combination of factors, including mechanisms associated with diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN) and neuropathic pain. In this study, 178 participants with type 1 diabetes (T1D) (n = 79 without DPN, 53 with painless DPN, 46 with painful DPN) and 48 healthy control individuals underwent structural brain MRI. Whole-brain and regional BAG were derived from the volBrain pipeline. Participants with T1D had an average of 3.5 years of increased BAG compared with healthy control individuals (P = 0.001). S
issue_review.result_excerpt: etes, but its links with diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN) and neuropathic pain remain unclear. We explored brain age gap (BAG) in type 1 diabetes to determine if it differs across neuropathic phenotypes, relates to clinical characteristics including DPN measures, and shows distinct regional patterns. Diabetes participants had 3.5 years of BAG, rising to 6-7 years in those with DPN. Diabetes duration was the main driver of BAG, whereas DPN had limited impact and neuropathic pain no clear contribution. BAG was widespread across the brain. Accelerated brain aging appears to affect people with diabetes regardless of neuropathic complications.

issue_review.finding_summary: GDM复发与较高后续T2D风险关联，不同族裔背景需分别考虑。
issue_review.method_excerpt: This retrospective cohort study included 326,115 mothers with singleton pregnancies in the Kaiser Permanente Southern California health care system, followed from their first delivery after January 2007 until diabetes onset outside of pregnancy, end of membership, or December 2022. GDM was identified through glucose screenings during each pregnancy; diabetes was diagnosed using glucose or HbA1c levels, antidiabetes medications, or ICD codes. Cox regression models with time-varying GDM status estimated hazard ratios (HRs) and 95% CIs for diabetes risk.
issue_review.result_excerpt: Compared with no GDM, GDM was significantly associated with higher diabetes risk, with recurrent GDM doubling the risk, underscoring the need for tailored screening and prevention strategies across racial and ethnic groups.

issue_review.method_excerpt: Women with GDM who delivered in New York City (NYC) in 2009-2011 were identified through birth certificate records and hospital discharge data and linked to NYC A1C Registry data (2009-2021) for follow-up. Women with prepregnancy diabetes were excluded. A previously published neighborhood walkability index was categorized into quartiles. Type 2 diabetes was ascertained as two A1C results ≥6.5% (48 mmol/mol) after 12 weeks postpartum. Cox proportional hazards models estimated associations between walkability and type 2 diabetes after GDM, adjusting for individual- and neighborhood-level charact
issue_review.result_excerpt: In NYC, more walkable neighborhoods were associated with lower risk of type 2 diabetes after GDM without a dose-response effect, and associations depended on individual and neighborhood socioeconomic contexts. While increasing walkability is a core planning goal and may improve health, decisions should also address neighborhood inequities in diabetes.

The tree structure revealed a continuous landscape of body composition phenotypes, with distinct spatial gradients for fat and lean mass. Within the phenotypic tree, fat-dominant phenotypes clustered in the region of low dimension 1 and low dimension 2 (corresponding to the lower left branches), where they demonstrated significant spatial overlap with high
issue_review.result_excerpt: termine whether a data-driven framework integrating detailed body composition measures could better describe obesity-related phenotypic heterogeneity and its relationship with cardiometabolic risk in children. issue_review.method_excerpt: Western diet (WD), characterized by high energy density and saturated fat, promotes obesity and insulin resistance (IR), yet how dietary lipid overload remodels skeletal muscle lipids at the subcellular level remains unclear. We investigated whether WD alters lipid class distribution and fatty acid (FA) incorporation within distinct muscle organelles and whether these changes relate to metabolic health. C57BL/6J mice were fed WD or control chow for 12 weeks. Mitochondria and lipid droplets (LDs) were isolated from soleus for organelle-resolved lipidomics. WD induced obesity, dyslipidemia, early IR, and intramyocellular lipid accumulation with
issue_review.result_excerpt: ces compartment-specific changes in skeletal muscle lipid classes and fatty acid (FA) composition and how these relate to metabolic health. Western diet disrupts the relationship between lipids and metabolism. Diacylglycerol FA composition reflected dietary supply. Phospholipid remodeling was class and compartment specific. Lipid droplet-localized 1,3-diacylglycerol, phosphatidylethanolamine, and phosphatidylglycerol reflected muscle health. These results highlight subcellular lipid organization as a key determinant of muscle insulin resistance and provide a framework for identifying early lipid signatures relevant to human diabetes research.

issue_review.finding_summary: irisin基因递送在Akita小鼠中提供肝糖代谢的非胰岛素调控线索。
issue_review.method_excerpt: Insulin has been regarded as the central regulator of systemic glucose homeostasis through regulation of hepatic glucose metabolism. Loss of insulin leads to dysregulation of glucose homeostasis in diabetes. Physical activity improves glycemic control in insulin-resistant and insulin-deficient states. However, it remains unclear whether exercise regulates hepatic glucose metabolism independently of insulin signaling. Irisin, an exercise-induced myokine cleaved from fibronectin type III domain-containing 5 (FNDC5), has been implicated in systemic metabolic regulation; however, its role in hepatic glucose metabolism plasticity under insulin-def
issue_review.result_excerpt: er irisin can directly regulate hepatic glucose metabolism and manage diabetic phenotypes in insulin-deficient Akita mice. Irisin improved diabetic phenotypes and was associated with enhanced glucose uptake (peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor-γ/GLUT2/GCK axis), increased glycogen storage (GSK-3β-dependent and GSK-3β-independent pathways), and reduced gluconeogenic activity, accompanied by increased AMPK phosphorylation independently of increases in insulin levels. These findings identify irisin as an insulin-independent regulator in hepatic glucose metabolism and suggest a potential therapeutic strategy for insulin-deficient diabetes.

issue_review.finding_summary: 随机研究中数字干预联合CGM较仅CGM加常规照护显示额外代谢改善。
issue_review.method_excerpt: The study was a 6-month, multicentre, open-label RCT conducted at 24 sites in Germany (ID: DRKS00032537). Adults (≥18 years) with non-insulin-treated type 2 diabetes (HbA1c 53-97 mmol/mol [7.0-11.0%], BMI≥25 kg/m2) receiving standard care were randomly assigned (1:1) by centralised stratified block randomisation to glucura or a control app. Participants and study personnel were not masked to group assignment. Both groups used intermittent CGM every 3 months during the study. CGM sensors were not used prior to the study. The primary endpoint was the change in HbA1c from baseline to 6 months. Se
issue_review.result_excerpt: In non-insulin-treated type 2 diabetes, CGM plus standard care yielded less metabolic benefit than CGM combined with glucura. The combination of glucura and CGM also translated into improvements beyond glycaemic management. Trial registration German Clinical Trials Register DRKS00032537 Funding The study was funded by Perfood Laboratories GmbH.

issue_review.method_excerpt: We undertook this study because albuminuria and estimated glomerular filtration rate often identify diabetic kidney disease risk only after substantial kidney injury in type 1 diabetes. We asked whether blood DNA methylation patterns could predict future DKD progression and improve clinical risk stratification. Genome-wide leukocyte methylation sequencing identified hypomethylated regions and a four-locus methylation risk score (SLC4A4, FSTL4, ICA1, and PTK2) that improved prediction beyond clinical risk models and was validated in 330 participants. issue_review.result_excerpt: ation rate often identify diabetic kidney disease risk only after substantial kidney injury in type 1 diabetes. We asked whether blood DNA methylation patterns could predict future DKD progression and improve clinical risk stratification. Genome-wide leukocyte methylation sequencing identified hypomethylated regions and a four-locus methylation risk score (SLC4A4, FSTL4, ICA1, and PTK2) that improved prediction beyond clinical risk models and was validated in 330 participants. Podocyte multiomics showed concordant hyperglycemia-induced hypomethylation and gene activation, supporting the biological plausibility of the blood-derived risk score.

issue_review.method_excerpt: This double-blind, multicentre, randomised, placebo-controlled, phase 2b trial was done in 19 academic hospital centres across Belgium, France, Germany, Switzerland, and the Netherlands. Eligible participants were aged 6-35 years; had a diagnosis of type 1 diabetes; received insulin for less than 3 months; and had a peak C-peptide concentration of at least 0·2 pmol/mL. issue_review.result_excerpt: Despite robust Treg expansion confirming target engagement, low-dose IL-2 did not preserve β-cell function in people with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes. The inflammatory environment at diagnosis might be too intense for this monotherapy, but the observed safety profile and confirmed biological activity support further investigation of low-dose IL-2 in earlier disease stages or combination strategies.

issue_review.finding_summary: 真实世界比较未发现两种SGLT2药物肝失代偿风险的显著差异。
issue_review.method_excerpt: Using nationwide Korean claims data, we constructed a new-user cohort of adults with MASLD, defined as having type 2 diabetes and a fatty liver index (FLI) ≥60, who initiated empagliflozin or dapagliflozin between May 2016 and December 2023. Outcomes of interest were FLI-defined MASLD regression (achieving FLI <30) and decompensated hepatic events (ascites, variceal bleeding, hepatic failure, liver transplantation). After 1:1 propensity score matching, HRs and 95% CIs were estimated using Cox models.
issue_review.result_excerpt: Among individuals with MASLD, no significant differences were observed between empagliflozin and dapagliflozin in the risk of decompensated hepatic events.

issue_review.method_excerpt: Non-communicable disease risk factor surveys using standardised protocols were conducted in the general population in 1987, 1992, 1998, 2004, 2009, 2015, and 2021 in Mauritius, with 36 744 survey attendances by adults aged 25-74 years examined. The participation rate was more than 85% in each survey. Participants had fasting plasma glucose measured at the survey site by site staff, and those who were not pregnant or taking glucose-lowering medication had an OGTT. Blood samples were immediately centrifuged to isolate plasma for glucose measurement. Glycaemic status was classified according to W
issue_review.result_excerpt: Mauritius is the first country to show a decreasing prevalence of type 2 diabetes and intermediate hyperglycaemia over time, using the objective, gold standard OGTT-based diagnostic criteria recommended by the WHO. These results underscore that national efforts to prevent and control type 2 diabetes can reduce its burden; systematic monitoring of diabetes and intermediate hyperglycaemia occurrence using the OGTT is crucial.

This combination microgel technology could offer a more favorable risk-benefit pr
issue_review.result_excerpt: mproves graft vascularization. issue_review.result_excerpt: In this largest study to date on the use of glucose-lowering agents in pregnancy, first-trimester exposure to second-line glucose-lowering agents was not associated with an increased risk of major congenital malformations when compared with insulin-only use. issue_review.method_excerpt: SELECT (Semaglutide Effects on Cardiovascular Outcomes in People with Overweight or Obesity Trial) evaluated the cardiovascular benefits of semaglutide in adults (mean age 62, 72% men) with obesity and preexisting atherosclerotic disease without diabetes. This prespecified analysis evaluated participants randomized to semaglutide who continued treatment for a minimum of 1 year. Baseline demographics, medical history, laboratory variables, and clinical measurements were candidate predictors of peak %BWL evaluated in a general linear model estimated with ordinary least squares.
issue_review.result_excerpt: The peak amount of weight loss expected following initiation of semaglutide cannot be predicted based on clinically available baseline characteristics; unmeasured biological, behavioral, or genetic differences are likely responsible for variability in individual response. Women treated with the highest dose of semaglutide experienced the largest %BWL.

issue_review.method_excerpt: Experiencing an involuntary weight loss plateau is common after behavioral weight loss. During such periods, sustained negative energy balance activates counterregulatory mechanisms that restore energy balance and may slow further weight loss. However, the cellular bioenergetic changes occurring specifically during a spontaneous weight loss plateau have not been investigated. We studied mitochondrial respiratory capacity in peripheral mononuclear cell populations from participants with obesity, both before and after an intensive lifestyle intervention (ILI). issue_review.method_excerpt: We analysed data from 9550 adults with type 2 diabetes who were followed for 5 years in the Fenofibrate Intervention and Event Lowering in Diabetes (FIELD) study. The composite index MVX (metabolic vulnerability), and its components IVX (inflammation vulnerability index) and MMX (metabolic malnutrition index), were derived from baseline plasma NMR. Associations with mortality and non-fatal events were assessed using Cox models adjusted for clinical variables and treatment allocation. Predictive performance was assessed using C statistics and variable contribution analysis.
issue_review.result_excerpt: MVX independently predicts total and cardiovascular mortality in type 2 diabetes, offering prognostic value beyond traditional risk factors. The absolute event rates reflect the treatment standards of the FIELD recruitment period (1997-2000), prior to widespread use of several contemporary cardioprotective therapies. The results support further investigation of the clinical utility of MVX for determination of personalised risk.

issue_review.method_excerpt: Metabolic alterations in obesity encompass impaired thermogenesis and sympathetic activity, underscoring the need for new metabolic targets to treat this disease. This study tested whether inhibition of PDE4 by rolipram enhances energy expenditure and brown adipose tissue activity. Rolipram reduced body weight and adiposity and increased brown adipose tissue temperature, UCP1 protein levels, noradrenaline levels, and enhanced excitability of hypothalamic paroventricular nucleus neurons. These findings suggest that central PDE4 inhibition promotes brown adipose tissue thermogenic activity and contributes to the metabolic effects of rolipram.

issue_review.result_excerpt: These findings suggest that an impaired thalamic neuronal and altered bioenergetic state, potentially consistent with impaired oxidative phosphorylation, exists in painless DPN, and that preservation of thalamic bioenergetic and neuronal profiles could be an important central mechanism of painful DPN. issue_review.finding_summary: PROTECT符合方案分析显示teplizumab组β细胞功能保留等结局改善。
issue_review.method_excerpt: Participants aged 8-17 years with stage 3 type 1 diabetes with a peak stimulated C-peptide level ≥0.2 nmol/l (ITT population: N=328) were randomised 2:1 to receive two 12-day courses of teplizumab or placebo intravenously. Participants with <80% treatment adherence, who took prohibited medication, received incorrect study treatment or were pregnant were excluded from the PP population. Subgroup analyses were based on the presence of HLA-DR3 or HLA-DR4 and the type of baseline type 1 diabetes autoantibodies.
issue_review.result_excerpt: Teplizumab treatment per protocol led to greater beta cell function preservation, greater TIR and lower exogenous insulin use compared with placebo. issue_review.method_excerpt: The progressive decline of functional β-cell mass is a hallmark of type 2 diabetes (T2D), yet no current therapies effectively halt this process. While chronic inflammation and metabolic stress contribute to β-cell dysfunction, the key signals integrating these pathways remain elusive. Circulating adenosine deaminase (ADA) elevation in people with diabetes is often viewed as a bystander effect, not a pathogenic component. Here, we show that this elevation reflects a failed compensatory response in a previously unknown purinergic pathway linking dyslipidemia to β-cell failure. Circulating lipids trigger rapid ATP release from erythrocytes, con
issue_review.result_excerpt: We identify tissue-specific compensatory ADA upregulation that paradoxically fails to prevent systemic ADO accumulation, with elevated adenosine selectively inducing apoptosis in immune and pancreatic β-cells. We establish a novel systemic clearance-local decompression therapeutic mechanism in which exogenous ADA reduces circulating ADO, normalizes compensatory tissue ADA hyperactivity, and rescues islet function. This work redefines plasma ADA from a diagnostic marker to a therapeutic target, providing the rationale for an ADA-based therapy that uniquely combines immune modulation with metabolic correction to halt β-cell failure progression.

issue_review.method_excerpt: Impaired cognitive function caused by insulin-induced hypoglycemia is a complication of type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM) for which no protective strategies are currently available. In a randomized dietary intervention trial of participants with T1DM and recurrent hypoglycemia, receiving medium-chain triglycerides (MCTs) as a dietary ketone precursor was associated with higher working m
issue_review.result_excerpt: are currently no strategies to prevent cognitive impairment caused by insulin-induced hypoglycemia in type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM). We examined whether β-hydroxybutyrate (BHB) supports brain metabolism during clamped hypoglycemia and whether dietary medium-chain triglycerides (MCTs), by raising BHB availability, elicit this protective effect. BHB contributed more to brain metabolism in participants with T1DM than in healthy control participants, and long-term MCT supplementation improved working memory and brain activation during hypoglycemia. Dietary MCT supplementation may protect against hypoglycemia-related cognitive deficits in T1DM.

Ten participants, whose T2D was managed by diet and/or metformin monotherapy (n = 4 men and 6 women; mean ± SEM age 68.2 ± 3.4 years, BMI 31.7 ± 1.2 kg/m2, HbA1c 6.9% ± 0.6%), were studied on two occasions in a double-blind, randomized, crossover design. During each study visit, hyperglycemia (∼15 mmol/L) was maintained for 210 m
issue_review.result_excerpt: diabetes (T2D), although its metabolic and cardiovascular effects remain incompletely understood. GIP stimulated insulin secretion and increased whole-body glucose disposal during hyperglycemia while modestly attenuating glucagon suppression and impairing insulin sensitivity. Our findings demonstrate that GIP remains biologically active in T2D and pharmacological doses modulate glucose metabolism and cardiovascular function.

The mechanisms underlying these differential responses to diabetogenic stress, particularly differences in their DNA damage vulnerability, remain unclear. We demonstrate that replication introduces a window of genomic vulnerability in both α- and β-cells during neonatal growth, with α-cells exhibiting higher replication rates and DNA damage. We show that neonatal β-cells
issue_review.result_excerpt: er replication, repair fidelity, and developmental epigenetic programs determine the vulnerability of postnatal β- and α-cells to DNA damage, a key driver of β-cell failure in diabetes. Replication introduces DNA damage vulnerability in both neonatal β- and α-cells, yet β-cells resolve damage more efficiently. Loss of DNA methyltransferase 3a in pancreatic progenitors selectively heightens β-cell DNA damage vulnerability that persists into adulthood. Moreover, diabetogenic stress preferentially compromises β-cell repair fidelity. These findings reveal how developmental programs shape β-cell resilience and may influence lifelong diabetes risk.

issue_review.result_excerpt: therapeutic strategy for DR. issue_review.method_excerpt: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a major cause of vision loss in working-age adults with diabetes. Increasing evidence implicates neuroinflammation as a vital element in the disease process of DR, yet the molecular mechanisms by which neuroinflammation activation occurs are not fully understood. This study shows that elevated glucose levels enhance O-GlcNAcylation of voltage-dependent anion channel 1 (VDAC1) at threonine 165. This modification promotes VDAC1 oligomerization, facilitating cytosolic translocation of mtDNA. The cytosolic mtDNA activates Z-DNA binding protein 1, leading to its activation and subsequent inflammatory responses. Importa
issue_review.result_excerpt: hat couples metabolic dysregulation with neuroinflammation, offering mechanistic insights and therapeutic opportunities for DR. The limited efficacy of anti-VEGF therapy in diabetic retinopathy (DR) highlights the importance of nonvascular mechanisms in disease progression. Hyperglycemia is a key driver of neuroinflammation in DR. Hyperglycemia results in VDAC1 O-GlcNAcylation in Müller glia, leading to mtDNA release and ZBP1 activation, thereby linking metabolic stress to neuroinflammation in DR. Targeting VDAC1-mediated mtDNA release or using vitreous mtDNA as a biomarker may enable earlier diagnosis and novel therapeutic strategies for DR.

Mechanistically, FcRn upregulation in diabetic podocytes exacerbated insulin resistance, suppressed AKT/mTOR signaling, and impa
issue_review.result_excerpt: nts a promising therapeutic strategy. Neonatal Fc receptor (FcRn) mediates podocyte injury in immune complex nephropathies, but its role in diabetic kidney disease (DKD) remains undefined. This study demonstrates marked FcRn upregulation in DKD podocytes and elucidates the functional consequences of podocyte FcRn deficiency. FcRn deficiency protects podocytes in DKD by restoring autophagy via enhanced insulin sensitivity and subsequent AKT/mTOR signaling activation. These findings identify FcRn as a novel therapeutic target for DKD, offering a strategy to mitigate the substantial residual risk of disease progression despite current therapies.

issue_review.finding_summary: 脂氧合酶删除在实验模型中保护视网膜功能并改变部分miRNA。
issue_review.method_excerpt: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) remains a leading cause of blindness, characterized by progressive neurovascular dysfunction. While the enzyme 12/15-lipoxygenase (12/15-LO) and its metabolites are upregulated in DR, their interactions with epigenetic regulators, such as miRNAs, are poorly understood. This study investigates the role of 12/15-LO in miRNA dysregulation and its functional consequences in a type 1 diabetic mouse model. We generated 12/15-LO knockout mice on an (Ins2+/akita) (Akita) background. Retinal miRNA expression was profiled using microarray analysis, and retinal structure and function were assessed using histology and electroret
issue_review.result_excerpt: th DR progression. Retina of Akita diabetic mice demonstrated significant thinning and dysfunction. Deletion of 12/15-lipoxygenase (12/15-LO) in Akita diabetic mice, an essential enzyme that metabolizes arachidonic acid to 12- and 15-hydroxyeicosatetraenoic acids, restored normal retinal thickness and preserved retinal neurons and function. Deletion of 12/15-LO selectively restored essential mature forms of miRNA, such as miR431 and miR329, which are implicated in neuroprotection, synaptic plasticity, and cellular response to stress. Targeting 12/15-LO and its metabolites has the potential to protect retina against diabetes neurodegeneration.

issue_review.method_excerpt: A regional, registry-based cohort study was conducted using linked routinely collected health care data from adults with diabetes and a first recorded CNO diagnosis in the National Health Service Greater Glasgow and Clyde, Scotland (2015-2024). Outcomes were all-cause emergency hospitalization, lower-extremity amputation, all-cause mortality, and amputation-free survival. Time-to-event methods and multivariable regression were used to estimate event probabilities and tested associations with clinical characteristics.
issue_review.result_excerpt: Adverse outcomes in CNO were frequent and occurred early after diagnosis, with high rates of emergency hospitalization, amputation, and death. These findings support CNO as a marker of systemic vulnerability and highlight the need for prioritized surveillance and multidisciplinary management in routine clinical care.

issue_review.finding_summary: 临床亚型对应不同胰岛细胞构成和应激模式，属于探索性单细胞图谱。
issue_review.method_excerpt: We applied the established type 2 diabetes clustering framework with independent validation against external centroids to evaluate subtype assignment accuracy across 43 pancreatic islet donors with type 2 diabetes. High-throughput single-cell RNA sequencing data comprising 131,083 cells from 32 pancreatic islet donors were subsequently analysed to systematically compare cellular composition and subtype-associated molecular perturbation patterns across these subgroups.
issue_review.result_excerpt: Our study provides an exploratory single-cell map of subtype-associated transcriptomic patterns in pancreatic islets across clinically defined type 2 diabetes subgroups. These findings serve as a valuable resource for future investigations exploring the cellular and molecular heterogeneity underlying type 2 diabetes pathogenesis.

issue_review.method_excerpt: Women with gestational diabetes and BMI ≥25 kg/m2 were randomized to a standard- (2,000 kcal/day) or reduced-energy (1,200 kcal/day) diet from ∼29 to -36 weeks' gestation, with follow-up to 12 months postnatally. We performed both trial and cohort analyses, using adjusted linear and logistic regression and a Super-Imposition by Translation and Rotation model.
issue_review.result_excerpt: Among women with gestational diabetes and high BMI, energy restriction or weight loss in pregnancy were associated with no adverse effects on offspring weight or growth in the first year. Future work will assess associations with child obesity at 3 years.

issue_review.method_excerpt: Key entry criteria of this phase 3, randomized, placebo-controlled trial included type 2 diabetes (per World Health Organization guidelines), HbA1c 7.0-10.5% (53-91 mmol/mol), fasting plasma glucose ≤13.9 mmol/L, and ≥8 weeks of diet and exercise. Participants were randomized and treated 2:1 to HTD1801 1,000 mg twice daily (BID) (n = 271) or placebo (n = 136). The primary end point was the change from baseline in HbA1c at week 24. After completion of a 24-week, double-blind trial, participants could enter a 28-week open-label extension during which everyone received HTD1801 1,000 mg BID. Safet
issue_review.result_excerpt: HTD1801 treatment produced sustained improvements in glycemic, cardiometabolic, and inflammatory parameters, supporting further evaluation as a well-tolerated oral therapy for patients with type 2 diabetes.

issue_review.result_excerpt: Complication patterns in Africans with type 2 diabetes who are lean vs overweight/obese follow divergent paths. Participants were followed up for 24 weeks with assessment of fasting
issue_review.result_excerpt: The glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist dulaglutide therapy was associated with greater improvements in glycaemic control and variability compared with insulin among adolescents with TDT-induced diabetes, without risk of hypoglycaemia or compromising safety. These findings are exploratory and clinically provocative, warranting further investigation.

issue_review.method_excerpt: Participants were randomized to one of three groups for 6 months: 8-h TRE (eating only between 12:00 p.m. and 8:00 p.m., without calorie counting) versus CR (25% energy restriction daily), and compared with a no-intervention control group. The primary outcome was percent change in body weight by month 6.
issue_review.result_excerpt: These findings suggest that TRE may be a safe approach for reducing HbA1c levels in T1D, although not more effective for weight loss compared with CR or a control group.

issue_review.method_excerpt: We conducted a non-randomised, phase 2, multi-centre, open-label clinical study. Participants with type 1 diabetes receiving at least one islet transplant were treated with belatacept/sirolimus (bela/siro) and compared with a contemporaneous cohort treated with tacrolimus/mycophenolate mofetil (tac/MMF). The primary outcome was freedom from hypoglycaemia, with positive C-peptide and HbA1c <53 mmol/mol (7.0%) at 12 months after the first transplant. Secondary outcomes included metabolic control (Igls criteria, BETA-2 score), allosensitisation and changes in peripheral blood immune cell populati
issue_review.result_excerpt: Baseline immunosuppression with bela/siro facilitated early islet engraftment and rates of insulin independence, with less impact on renal function, supporting the rationale for routine use in islet transplantation.

issues.name: 谁会从胰岛自身免疫进展为T1D
issues.boundary_text: 起病前抗体、遗传、环境和胰腺功能的风险线索；药物干预另列。
issues.progress_summary: 人群筛查与纵向随访显示进展风险存在异质性，同时保留短链脂肪酸和疫苗相关研究的阴性结果。
issues.limits_text: 风险关联与发病机制不是同一证据；早期信号尚需核对预测和干预用途。

issues.name: β细胞身份、应激损伤与保护
issues.boundary_text: β细胞身份稳态、DNA修复、炎症应激及再生相关机制。
issues.progress_summary: 离体细胞和动物研究从修复、身份调控及应激保护提出多条干预路径；部分涉及人胰岛。
issues.limits_text: 人胰岛离体实验不等于患者临床验证；各靶点仅作机制线索。

issues.name: 糖尿病前期及T2D亚型的进展风险
issues.boundary_text: 临床/代谢分型、体成分与进展或并发症差异；单细胞机制另列。
issues.progress_summary: 已有队列分层与干预试验二次分析，提示亚型间风险及生活方式响应不同；儿童、不同地区人群的分型也在扩展。
issues.limits_text: 亚型定义、人群与结局不同，不能把各篇分型当成可互换诊断工具。

issues.name: T1D与非自身免疫糖尿病的遗传鉴别
issues.boundary_text: 遗传背景、抗体阴性鉴别和成人T1D异质性。
issues.progress_summary: 遗传评分与多祖源/HLA分层研究连接糖尿病鉴别及胰岛素分泌、抵抗差异。
issues.limits_text: 遗传关联、临床鉴别和亚型观察回答不同问题，需核阈值与外部适用性。

issues.name: T1D免疫干预的应答差异与持续性
issues.boundary_text: 免疫治疗、应答预测、停药与亚组差异。
issues.progress_summary: Teplizumab试验分析、GAD-alum亚组随访、baricitinib停药与低剂量IL-2结果可对照阅读。IL-2虽有靶向生物反应，未保留β细胞功能。
issues.limits_text: 药物、人群、疾病阶段与终点不同，不横向比较疗效大小；阴性与停药后衰减同样保留。

issues.name: CGM指导不同人群的日常血糖管理
issues.boundary_text: 管理效果及特定场景，不包括早期分期诊断。
issues.progress_summary: 从目标试验模拟、纵向CGM到数字干预RCT及透析/肠外营养场景，研究覆盖逐步扩展。
issues.limits_text: 死亡关联属于观察性模拟；透析/肠外营养人群证据不可直接外推。

issues.name: 妊娠期管理与母婴安全
issues.boundary_text: 体重、营养、用药及产后喂养。
issues.progress_summary: 孕期体重/能量研究、用药暴露队列与产后喂养观察共同补充安全问题。
issues.limits_text: 不把观察性暴露安全、随机随访和婴儿一年生长等同长期安全结论。
issues.board_name: 妊娠、肌骨与内分泌共病

issues.name: 生活方式和体成分与预防结局
issues.boundary_text: 长期体重、肌少型肥胖、环境及饮食风险。
issues.progress_summary: 长期队列连接生命历程体重、体成分与预防结局；存在步行环境与钠摄入等可研究因素。
issues.limits_text: 观察性关联不直接证明生活方式改变的因果效果；社会经济和其他混杂需核。

issues.name: 日常照护、睡眠与心理体验
issues.boundary_text: 照护环境与患者体验，不作为生物学机制。
issues.progress_summary: 动态感受、学校管理和睡眠研究提示CGM指标之外的照护需求。
issues.limits_text: 血糖指标与心理感受并非一一对应，不能将关联当作干预有效证据。

issues.name: 胰岛微环境如何调节炎症和分泌
issues.boundary_text: 腺苷、巨噬细胞、血管周细胞及局部分泌信号。
issues.progress_summary: 研究连接胰岛炎症屏障、营养支持和受体依赖的分泌调控。
issues.limits_text: 主要为机制证据；不同细胞来源与物种的作用不能互换。

issues.name: 胰岛移植的局部免疫保护与移植物存活
issues.boundary_text: 移植物免疫保护、微凝胶、MSC及EV；肾脏长期安全另列。
issues.progress_summary: 已有非随机临床免疫抑制研究，以及微凝胶、MSC/EV的临床前移植物保护证据。
issues.limits_text: 系统免疫抑制方案与局部保护材料的证据层次不同，不能视作临床替代。

issues.name: AID疗效轨迹与个体化胰岛素需求
issues.boundary_text: 自动胰岛素输注的人群疗效、行为及生理差异。
issues.progress_summary: AID启用后总体血糖可改善，但低血糖高风险人群、月经周期及基线行为影响个体结果。
issues.limits_text: T1D与T2D、单臂与观察研究不等同；不能称所有人持续同样获益。

issues.name: CGM能否用于早期分期及动态生理评估
issues.boundary_text: 起病前分期、OGTT对照、β细胞功能与心代谢表型。
issues.progress_summary: 已有CGM与动态负荷/风险指标对照的研究，提示传统血糖指标之外的信息。
issues.limits_text: 传感器系统差异、血浆对照和功能估计需核，不直接替代诊断标准。

issues.name: 多受体与胰淀素方案的减重证据
issues.boundary_text: 多受体/胰淀素相关人群试验；单独保留各方案与剂量。
issues.progress_summary: 已有mazdutide、petrelintide、acmopatide和CagriSema不同阶段试验；补充survodutide肥胖合并T2D结果及综述背景。
issues.limits_text: 不跨药物与人群直接排序疗效；系统评价单列，不重复计其纳入试验。

issues.name: 肠促胰素及α细胞的生理调节
issues.boundary_text: GIP、GLP-1、胰高血糖素分泌及微循环机制。
issues.progress_summary: 人体生理实验与代谢物机制研究提示激素作用受血糖、氨基酸和组织背景影响。
issues.limits_text: 急性生理实验、细胞机制与长期治疗获益分开解读。

issues.name: 肾病早期风险与动态进展评估
issues.boundary_text: 糖基化、甲基化/衰老及正常白蛋白尿背景的肾风险。
issues.progress_summary: 队列组学与动态轨迹研究试图补充传统肾功能/白蛋白尿信息，部分含验证样本或器官机制。
issues.limits_text: 各研究的结局、验证和增益须逐篇区分；不把同一结论推广到全部指标。

issues.name: MASLD分层与肝脂肪代谢异质性
issues.boundary_text: 肝纤维化风险、遗传亚型及脂质来源机制。
issues.progress_summary: 临床风险分层、遗传和小样本代谢影像共同提示MASLD与血糖风险关系存在异质性。
issues.limits_text: 研究尺度差异大，影像方法探索和遗传保护轴不能直接作为临床分层方案。

issues.name: GDM亚型与产后长期风险
issues.boundary_text: GDM分型、复发及产后代谢差异。
issues.progress_summary: 从数据驱动分型到长期随访，研究将亚型、复发和产后激素差异连接起来。
issues.limits_text: 分型标准、种族和随访年限不同，仍需核个体化干预用途。
issues.board_name: 妊娠、肌骨与内分泌共病

issues.name: 母体糖尿病与胎儿及子代代谢
issues.boundary_text: 胎盘/胎儿生长、子代风险及宫内机制。
issues.progress_summary: 影像、儿童队列及猪模型分别研究宫内影响；母体T1D与儿童自身免疫的相对保护也被保留。
issues.limits_text: 结局、年龄和物种不同，不能概括为所有子代风险都增加或降低。
issues.board_name: 妊娠、肌骨与内分泌共病

issues.name: T1D起病年龄与长期并发症
issues.boundary_text: 病程、起病年龄与死亡/并发症轨迹。
issues.progress_summary: 登记及随访研究连接起病时间、治疗年代与长期风险。
issues.limits_text: 年龄、病程和观察时长彼此相关，不直接比较不同队列的风险方向。

issues.name: 多时点组学与影像的发病风险预测
issues.boundary_text: 重复蛋白、儿童氨基酸及胰周脂肪影像的发病风险评估。
issues.progress_summary: 已有多时点队列、儿童长期随访及影像分析，增加传统单次测量之外的风险线索。
issues.limits_text: 关联、预测增益与实际临床决策价值需分别核对；不按同名指标合并性能。

issues.name: 脂肪来源EV如何影响胰岛与代谢
issues.boundary_text: 脂肪—胰岛细胞间通讯及EV功能，不作为检测技术研究。
issues.progress_summary: 脂肪来源EV在不同实验条件下既可增强胰岛素分泌，也可传递脂毒性应激。
issues.limits_text: 来源细胞、处理和货物不同；表面方向不同不等于同条件下矛盾。

issues.name: 低血糖风险与短期脑功能影响
issues.boundary_text: CGM严重低血糖风险以及认知/脑代谢影响。
issues.progress_summary: CGM风险分析、营养底物研究及实时认知评估分别提供风险、保护机制和时间窗口证据。
issues.limits_text: 不同研究的低血糖定义、测试条件和认知终点需分开。

issues.name: 治疗应答、缓解与复发能否预测
issues.boundary_text: 药物及代谢手术的个体应答预测。
issues.progress_summary: GLP1R变异、手术缓解/复发与SELECT减重分析提供不同预测路径；SELECT常规基线特征未能预测峰值减重。
issues.limits_text: 不能把所有研究都描述为已成功预测；二次分析需独立验证。

issues.name: 进食时序与餐后血糖调节
issues.boundary_text: 限时进食、餐前营养顺序及进食频率。
issues.progress_summary: 有人体限时进食试验，也有餐前橄榄油与夜间加餐的动物机制研究。
issues.limits_text: 人体与动物、热量与时序的作用须分开，不形成直接饮食建议。

issues.name: 肌肉代谢与胰岛素敏感性
issues.boundary_text: 肌肉脂质区室、生活方式及肌源信号。
issues.progress_summary: 区室脂质研究、减重/运动比较和DPT-GDF15机制补充肌肉代谢线索。
issues.limits_text: 不同物种与干预阶段不合并性能，需确认人体可转化环节。
issues.board_name: 妊娠、肌骨与内分泌共病

issues.name: 肾细胞损伤与代谢调控
issues.boundary_text: 足细胞/肾小管机制与疾病进展。
issues.progress_summary: 研究从自噬、乳酸化、线粒体与肾血流调控提出不同机制；CYP1B1材料仅作类型待核背景。
issues.limits_text: 主要为机制研究；CYP1B1摘要缺原始设计，暂不计原创数量。

issues.name: 视网膜损伤机制及保护干预
issues.boundary_text: 炎症、线粒体DNA、脂氧合酶等视网膜机制。
issues.progress_summary: 临床前研究提出长效局部递送及代谢炎症靶点。
issues.limits_text: 递送、分子通路和动物保护不等于患者视力获益。

issues.name: 神经病变的中枢改变与疼痛治疗
issues.boundary_text: 脑影像/生物能与疼痛、感觉功能干预。
issues.progress_summary: 影像研究与脊髓刺激RCT分别增加机制及干预证据，脑龄与疼痛的关系并非单一。
issues.limits_text: 影像关联不解释全部疼痛，短期感觉改善不能直接称为疾病修饰。

issues.name: 糖尿病足依从性与截肢后结局
issues.boundary_text: 足部治疗留存、Charcot及截肢长期结局。
issues.progress_summary: 试验二次分析和登记队列提示管理留存及长期系统脆弱性问题。
issues.limits_text: 治疗依从、截肢预后与系统共病是不同结局，不能简单合并风险比例。

issues.name: 心血管风险的多维评估
issues.boundary_text: 风险预测及自主神经相关生理信息。
issues.progress_summary: 预后队列、甲基化模型和胰岛素剂量的自主神经分析补充传统风险指标。
issues.limits_text: 不同模型和人群不可互换；历史队列治疗标准与当前不同。
issues.board_name: 心血管风险与多器官共病

issues.name: 流行趋势与急诊住院负担
issues.boundary_text: 妊娠/一般人群趋势及卫生服务负担。
issues.progress_summary: 不同地区重复调查和住院数据显示发病及服务负担的不同走向。
issues.limits_text: 人口构成、诊断标准和年代不同，不合成全球升降结论。

issues.name: MSC分泌物能否调节T1D免疫耐受
issues.boundary_text: MSC改造/激活后分泌物及免疫调节。
issues.progress_summary: PD-L1相关MSC与药理激活MSC分泌组在实验模型中显示免疫调节线索。
issues.limits_text: 均需进一步核临床可行性、制备一致性及安全性。

issues.name: T1D酮症酸中毒风险如何提前识别
issues.boundary_text: 酮体检测频率和残余分泌功能与DKA风险。
issues.progress_summary: 试验资料二次分析提示较低负担的酮体检测和C肽信息可能帮助风险分层。
issues.limits_text: 关联与风险模型仍需独立前瞻验证；不据此改变患者检测或用药。

issues.name: 口服肠促胰素药物的跨人群证据
issues.boundary_text: orforglipron在T2D与肥胖人群的试验。
issues.progress_summary: 日本T2D开放试验与肥胖安慰剂对照试验分别补充口服方案的安全和减重证据。
issues.limits_text: 两试验人群和比较方案不同，不能直接合并效果或推断适应证。

issues.name: 中枢信号与脂肪产热调控
issues.boundary_text: PDE4、FGF19/Rsk4与产热和能量稳态。
issues.progress_summary: 小鼠研究从中枢信号提出代谢调控路径。
issues.limits_text: 临床前机制，不推断人体减重疗效。

issues.name: 脂肪脂解与减重平台的代谢变化
issues.boundary_text: 脂质周转及减重平台/反弹时的免疫代谢。
issues.progress_summary: 脂酶底物选择性实验与减重阶段T细胞代谢研究分别解释脂质重塑和能量适应。
issues.limits_text: 两类研究对象不同，仅作补充机制，不能串成已验证因果链。

issues.name: 不同膳食模式的代谢效果
issues.boundary_text: DASH等饮食组成方案的干预效果。
issues.progress_summary: 控制喂养和随机饮食比较提供体重、血糖和尿酸等不同终点证据。
issues.limits_text: 减重并不等于各终点均有组间差异；不能把一套结果外推所有人群。

issues.name: 糖尿病骨折风险与骨结构变化
issues.boundary_text: 骨折风险及骨密度/微结构纵向证据。
issues.progress_summary: T1D/DKD骨折风险与T2D骨结构随访相互补充，后者未发现更快的外周骨丢失。
issues.limits_text: 人群和终点不同，不能把结果称作直接矛盾或否定骨折风险。
issues.board_name: 妊娠、肌骨与内分泌共病

issues.name: 糖肝共病的药物比较与器官效应
issues.boundary_text: 药物的肝脏效应及比较结果。
issues.progress_summary: 临床前双受体药物与真实世界SGLT2比较提供不同层次证据；后者未见两药肝失代偿风险差异。
issues.limits_text: 保留无差异结果，不把小鼠肝指标改善等同人体器官结局。

issues.name: GDM早期识别与妊娠风险
issues.boundary_text: 孕早期代谢检测、PMOS及围产风险。
issues.progress_summary: 前瞻观察研究把早期识别与围产风险相联系；改善GDM预测不等于改善LGA预测。
issues.limits_text: 需要干预研究确认早期预测能否改善母婴结局。
issues.board_name: 妊娠、肌骨与内分泌共病

issues.name: 医疗费用与胰岛素可及性
issues.boundary_text: 政策覆盖、住房及费用相关依从性。
issues.progress_summary: 政策估算与横断面数据揭示成本上限和经济脆弱性的覆盖缺口。
issues.limits_text: 政策估算不等于实施效果，队列与国家情境不直接外推。

issues.name: T2D临床亚型对应哪些胰岛细胞变化
issues.boundary_text: 临床分型到人胰岛单细胞图谱的对应关系。
issues.progress_summary: 已有单细胞研究把临床亚型与胰岛细胞构成、功能及应激变化联系起来。
issues.limits_text: 属于探索性图谱，不能据此认定分型已能指导临床治疗。

issues.name: 移植后免疫抑制与长期肾功能安全
issues.boundary_text: 胰岛移植后肾功能轨迹及免疫抑制风险。
issues.progress_summary: 长期单中心队列提示移植后肾功能下降呈阶段性，性别及基线肾功能影响风险。
issues.limits_text: 单中心观察性资料，需区分免疫抑制、基础病及选择因素。

issues.name: HTD1801单药的降糖疗效与安全
issues.boundary_text: HTD1801单药三期试验。
issues.progress_summary: 已有随机安慰剂对照三期结果，关注降糖主要终点和较长期安全性。
issues.limits_text: 摘要层面已读，通讯作者、完整不良事件及临床使用条件待核。

issues.name: 特殊糖尿病人群的药物方案
issues.boundary_text: 输血依赖地中海贫血相关糖尿病药物比较。
issues.progress_summary: 已有青少年特殊糖尿病人群的dulaglutide与胰岛素随机比较。
issues.limits_text: 小范围特殊病因研究，不能代替一般T2D证据。

issues.name: 视网膜影像随访与进展预测
issues.boundary_text: OCTA与非增殖性视网膜病变的长期轨迹。
issues.progress_summary: 长期随访把微血管灌注变化与病变进展联系起来。
issues.limits_text: 观察性影像线索，需要核临床阈值、重复性及外部验证。

issues.name: 生活方式与糖尿病认知衰退风险
issues.boundary_text: 心血管健康、遗传与认知结局。
issues.progress_summary: 两个人群数据集观察到较好心血管健康与认知风险的关联。
issues.limits_text: 仍是观察性证据，需考虑混杂和不同遗传风险背景。

issues.name: 糖尿病心肌病的蛋白修饰机制
issues.boundary_text: 乳酸化、蛋白互作和心肌能量代谢。
issues.progress_summary: 细胞/动物研究连接蛋白修饰、稳定性与心肌损伤。
issues.limits_text: 临床前机制，需补患者证据和靶点可行性。
issues.board_name: 心血管风险与多器官共病

issues.name: 肝糖代谢的非胰岛素调控
issues.boundary_text: irisin基因递送和肝糖代谢机制。
issues.progress_summary: Akita小鼠研究探索不依赖胰岛素增加的代谢调控。
issues.limits_text: 动物模型和基因递送可行性尚不能直接转化。

issues.name: 空气污染暴露与糖代谢共病
issues.boundary_text: 空气污染与已确诊糖尿病的代谢指标。
issues.progress_summary: 横断面研究发现T2D中污染暴露与代谢及共病关联较一致，T1D结果较弱。
issues.limits_text: 环境相关性需纵向和干预证据，不能认定个体因果。
